verdict.rationale: Evidence covers per-harness install mechanisms (Devin, Hermes, Claude Code plugin marketplace) and notes skills are plain markdown folders that can be selectively installed, but nowhere describes a way to list installed skills or a clean uninstall/removal process that avoids orphaned files or lingering instructions. Community commentary even flags the install mechanism as 'curl|bash but with added LLM agents,' underscoring the lack of a structured uninstall story.
